mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy, reducing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation requiring delayed rate cuts, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in payroll employment and decreases in unemployment rate signal a tight labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases, or Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, rising housing starts (HOUST) signal strong consumer confidence and construction activity, supporting earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST increases during late-cycle expansions, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust manufacturing activity and economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO increases, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) decline by more than 0.5% month-over-month, it signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS declines > 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in federal funds rate and declines in unemployment rate signal monetary tightening amid a strong labor market, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening with strong labor market
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS increases and UNRATE decreases, or Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During slow GDP growth regimes, a quarterly GDP growth rate below 1.0% signals economic deceleration, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth < 1.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.
